svg.text: Proposal · each is a formula drawn by the compositor, no image files · follows light/dark and the accent the moment they change · previews made with the same per-pixel math
Today's wallpaper, refined: a diagonal gradient with an accent glow. Now also light.
Layered ridges that pale toward the horizon; dusk in dark mode, warm sand in light.
Three curtains with bright, wavy hems in the accent and two companion colors.
Topographic lines over a soft gradient; quiet enough for busy desktops.
Plain fills for minimal desktops; any color can be typed in as hex.
Light/dark and accent changes redraw the wallpaper at once,
no reboot. A future day/night service (S3) can switch the mode
by time; the wallpaper follows it.
Dynamic (pick one of these), Solid color (swatches or hex),
and later Image. The login screen uses the same choice.
Drawn once per change at screen resolution, on the worker CPUs;
no per-frame cost. Contour and Aurora are the heaviest (~3x Zenith).
